title: Smart Data Models - Allotrope Foundation Ontologies - AnalyticalMethod
description: An analysis method is a plan specification that specifies an analysis. [Allotrope] (AFO REC/2026/09 class 'analytical method', http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0000895. The entity type is the PascalCase form of the AFO skos:prefLabel; attribute names are the camelCase form of the prefLabels of the AFO relations and facet classes they stand for.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AnalyticalMethod'

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. The name of this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

analyticalMethodIdentifier.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0001978'. AFO class 'analytical method identifier': An analytical method identifier is an identifier that identifies the analytical method used in a measurement. [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON.

methodName.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0001606'. AFO class 'method name': A method name is a name that denotes a plan specification (method). [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON.

methodVersion.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0002837'. AFO class 'method version': A method version is a version number that identifies a method. [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON.
